think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s data type and allowed values from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether it is a numeric knob (integer/real) with an inherent ordering. 3) If numeric, look for any sentinel/special values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (like disabling/enabling an unrelated behavior) rather than just scaling the same behavior. 4) If such sentinel values exist, classify as a special knob and record the special value(s); otherwise classify as not special.
